name: HaVeWa
description: Property management for rentals and HOAs Properties, units, leases, service-charge and HOA statements, dunning, documents, maintenance and portals.
longDescription:
Property-management software for rental and HOA (WEG) administration, with its own PostgreSQL: properties, units, people and meters; leases with stepped and index rent and deposits; charges, payments, open items, SEPA mandates and dunning; service-charge statements with a BetrKV allocation engine; co-ownership shares, economic plan, HOA fees, annual statement and reserves; owners meetings with agenda, voting and resolution collection; documents; maintenance tickets with workflow and time tracking; tenant and owner portals; camt.053 import and DATEV/SEPA export.

Multi-tenant, role-based and bilingual (German and English). A REST API and an MCP server with per-user tokens let an AI agent read and manage the portfolio under the same permissions a person has.

The first start opens a setup wizard for the administrator and the management company. The installer form asks for the session secret, so it never comes from a public file.
